high_level_description: This image captures a nighttime scene of a grand, illuminated building with a prominent flag flying atop it. The architecture is classical, featuring columns, arches, and a symmetrical design. The building is well-lit, with lights highlighting its facade and creating a warm glow against the dark sky. In front of the building, there is a large fountain with water jets shooting upwards, adding a dynamic element to the scene. The water reflects the lights from the building, enhancing the overall visual appeal. The sky is a deep blue, indicating that it is either dusk or early evening.
